items.scenario_zh: 通報壞消息（excursion 通知）
items.pattern: We regret to inform you that {lot} exhibited {failure_mode} during {test_stage}. As immediate containment, we have {action}.
items.pattern_zh: 很遺憾通知您，{批號} 在 {測試站} 出現 {失效模式}。作為立即圍堵措施，我們已 {動作}。
items.filled_example: We regret to inform you that lot A123 exhibited elevated read-disturb failures during MST. As immediate containment, we have put all sister lots on hold.

cloze.text: We ___ to inform you that lot A123 ___ elevated read-disturb failures during MST. As immediate ___, we have put all sister lots on hold.

dont.en: We are sorry, the lot has problem.
dont.why_zh: 太口語且文法錯誤；壞消息通知要用固定句式顯得可控。客戶讀到的是「你有沒有在管」，不是你的心情。

items.scenario_zh: 通報壞消息（先講影響範圍）
items.pattern: The issue affects {quantity} units from {work_week}. Of these, {shipped_qty} have already been shipped to you under {reference}.
items.pattern_zh: 本問題影響 {數量} 顆 {週次} 的產品，其中 {已出貨數} 顆已依 {出貨單號} 出貨給貴司。
items.filled_example: The issue affects 46 lots from WW30 to WW32. Of these, 12 lots have already been shipped to you under invoice INV-2208.

cloze.text: The issue ___ 46 lots from WW30 to WW32. ___ these, 12 lots have already been ___ to you under invoice INV-2208.

dont.en: Some lots may be affected, we are still checking.
dont.why_zh: 客戶第一時間要的是「有多少到我這裡」。給不出精確數字就給範圍與更新時間，不要用 some 打發。

items.scenario_zh: 通報壞消息（附上時程承諾）
items.pattern: We will provide the interim 8D report by {date}, and the confirmed root cause by {date2}.
items.pattern_zh: 我們會在 {日期} 前提供 8D 期中報告，並於 {日期2} 前提出確認的根本原因。
items.filled_example: We will provide the interim 8D report by Wednesday 24 August, and the confirmed root cause by WW36.

cloze.text: We will ___ the interim 8D report ___ Wednesday 24 August, and the ___ root cause by WW36.

dont.en: We will send the report as soon as possible.
dont.why_zh: as soon as possible 在客戶眼中等於沒有日期。寧可給一個保守但守得住的日期。

items.scenario_zh: 通報壞消息（請客戶配合動作）
items.pattern: We kindly ask you to {customer_action} until we confirm {condition}.
items.pattern_zh: 在我們確認 {條件} 之前，敬請貴司先 {客戶動作}。
items.filled_example: We kindly ask you to quarantine the remaining stock until we confirm the screening result on the shipped lots.

cloze.text: We kindly ___ you to ___ the remaining stock ___ we confirm the screening result on the shipped lots.

dont.en: Please stop using our product now.
dont.why_zh: 沒有條件與期限的停用要求會被視為 recall 等級事件。要寫清楚「做什麼、到什麼時候為止」。

items.scenario_zh: 通報壞消息（承認資料落差）
items.pattern: We acknowledge the gap between your {their_data} and our {our_data}, and we are investigating the correlation.
items.pattern_zh: 我們確認貴司的 {對方資料} 與我方的 {我方資料} 之間存在落差，正在調查兩者的相關性。
items.filled_example: We acknowledge the gap between your incoming inspection result and our final test data, and we are investigating the correlation.

cloze.text: We ___ the gap between your incoming inspection result and our final test data, and we are ___ the ___.

dont.en: Our data is correct, please check your test again.
dont.why_zh: 第一封信就否認對方的數據會直接升級成爭端。先承認落差存在，再用資料把責任範圍講清楚。

items.scenario_zh: 要求展延（給理由與新日期）
items.pattern: We need to extend the {deliverable} deadline from {old_date} to {new_date} because {reason}.
items.pattern_zh: 由於 {原因}，我們需要將 {交付項目} 的期限從 {原日期} 延到 {新日期}。
items.filled_example: We need to extend the FA report deadline from 25 August to 1 September because the cross-section queue is longer than expected.

cloze.text: We need to ___ the FA report deadline ___ 25 August ___ 1 September because the cross-section queue is longer than expected.

dont.en: Sorry, we cannot finish on time.
dont.why_zh: 只講做不到卻不給新日期，對方無法排計畫。展延信的重點是新日期，不是道歉。

items.scenario_zh: 要求展延（說明已完成的部分）
items.pattern: Steps {done_steps} are complete; only {remaining} is outstanding, which requires {duration}.
items.pattern_zh: {已完成步驟} 已完成，只剩 {未完成項目}，需要 {所需時間}。
items.filled_example: Steps D1 to D4 are complete; only the verification run is outstanding, which requires three production lots.

cloze.text: Steps D1 to D4 are ___; only the verification run is ___, which ___ three production lots.

dont.en: We are still working on it.
dont.why_zh: 把已完成與未完成拆開寫，展延才有說服力；只說 still working 會被讀成沒有進度。

items.scenario_zh: 要求展延（提出折衷方案）
items.pattern: If {full_deliverable} by {date} is critical for you, we can provide {partial} first and the remainder by {date2}.
items.pattern_zh: 若貴司必須在 {日期} 前拿到 {完整交付}，我們可以先提供 {部分內容}，其餘於 {日期2} 補上。
items.filled_example: If the full 8D by Friday is critical for you, we can provide the containment section first and the remainder by WW36.

cloze.text: If the full 8D by Friday is ___ for you, we can ___ the containment section first and the ___ by WW36.

dont.en: It is impossible to finish by Friday.
dont.why_zh: impossible 是死路。給折衷方案讓對方選，你才保有主動權。

items.scenario_zh: 要求展延（設備或資源限制）
items.pattern: The {resource} is fully booked until {date}; this is the constraint driving the new schedule.
items.pattern_zh: {資源} 在 {日期} 前都已排滿，這是新時程受限的原因。
items.filled_example: The SEM is fully booked until 30 August; this is the constraint driving the new schedule.

cloze.text: The SEM is fully ___ until 30 August; this is the ___ driving the new ___.

dont.en: Our machine is busy so we are late.
dont.why_zh: 口語且像藉口。指名資源、給出解除日期，才會被當成可管理的限制條件。

items.scenario_zh: 要求展延（承諾不再延）
items.pattern: This is a one-time extension. We have added {buffer} to the plan so that the new date holds even if {risk} occurs.
items.pattern_zh: 本次為一次性展延。我們已在計畫中加入 {緩衝}，即使 {風險} 發生也能守住新日期。
items.filled_example: This is a one-time extension. We have added one week of buffer to the plan so that the new date holds even if the retest fails.

cloze.text: This is a ___ extension. We have added one week of ___ to the plan so that the new date ___ even if the retest fails.

dont.en: We hope there will be no more delay.
dont.why_zh: hope 不是承諾。講出你做了什麼讓新日期站得住，才叫承諾。

items.scenario_zh: 進度更新（三段式標準結構）
items.pattern: Status as of {date}: {done} is complete, {in_progress} is in progress, and {next} starts on {date2}.
items.pattern_zh: 截至 {日期} 的狀態：{已完成} 已完成，{進行中} 進行中，{下一步} 於 {日期2} 開始。
items.filled_example: Status as of 22 August: containment is complete, cross-section analysis is in progress, and the verification run starts on 29 August.

cloze.text: ___ as of 22 August: containment is ___, cross-section analysis is in ___, and the verification run starts on 29 August.

dont.en: Everything is going well.
dont.why_zh: 沒有資訊量。固定用「已完成／進行中／下一步」三段，收信人三秒就能抓到狀態。

items.scenario_zh: 進度更新（沒有新進展時）
items.pattern: There is no change since my last update on {date}. The next meaningful data point is {milestone} on {date2}.
items.pattern_zh: 自 {日期} 上次更新以來沒有變化。下一個有意義的資料點是 {日期2} 的 {里程碑}。
items.filled_example: There is no change since my last update on Monday. The next meaningful data point is the retest result on Thursday.

cloze.text: There is no ___ since my last update on Monday. The next ___ data point is the retest result ___ Thursday.

dont.en: No update this week.
dont.why_zh: 沒進展也要說「下一個資料點在哪一天」，否則對方會每天來問。

items.scenario_zh: 進度更新（列出待辦與負責人）
items.pattern: Open items: (1) {item1} - owner {owner1}, due {date1}; (2) {item2} - owner {owner2}, due {date2}.
items.pattern_zh: 未結事項：(1) {項目1}，負責人 {人1}，期限 {日期1}；(2) {項目2}，負責人 {人2}，期限 {日期2}。
items.filled_example: Open items: (1) cross-section on two units - owner FA team, due 26 August; (2) tool log review - owner process team, due 24 August.

cloze.text: ___ items: (1) cross-section on two units - ___ FA team, ___ 26 August.

dont.en: We will do the cross-section and check the tool logs.
dont.why_zh: 沒有負責人與期限的待辦不會被完成。列表格式讓對方能直接追。

items.scenario_zh: 進度更新（提早示警）
items.pattern: One risk to flag early: if {condition}, the {milestone} may slip by {duration}. I will confirm by {date}.
items.pattern_zh: 先提早示警一個風險：若 {條件}，{里程碑} 可能延後 {時間}。我會在 {日期} 前確認。
items.filled_example: One risk to flag early: if the verification lots do not pass, the WW36 release may slip by two weeks. I will confirm by 30 August.

cloze.text: One ___ to flag early: if the verification lots do not pass, the WW36 release may ___ by two weeks. I will ___ by 30 August.

dont.en: Maybe there will be some delay, I am not sure.
dont.why_zh: 示警要具體：什麼條件、延多久、何時給答案。模糊的示警等於沒有示警。

items.scenario_zh: 進度更新（會議後的追蹤信）
items.pattern: Thank you for joining the call. To recap, we agreed on {agreement}. I will {my_action} by {date}, and you will {your_action}.
items.pattern_zh: 感謝您參加會議。重點回顧：我們就 {共識} 達成一致。我會在 {日期} 前 {我方動作}，貴司則 {對方動作}。
items.filled_example: Thank you for joining the call. To recap, we agreed on a two-step release. I will send the containment data by Friday, and you will confirm the quarantine quantity.

cloze.text: Thank you for joining the call. To ___, we ___ on a two-step release. I will send the containment data ___ Friday.

dont.en: Nice talking to you today.
dont.why_zh: 會後信的價值在白紙黑字固定共識與待辦。只寒暄等於這通會議沒有紀錄。

items.scenario_zh: 根因摘要（一句話講完機制）
items.pattern: The root cause is {cause}, which led to {effect} and resulted in {failure}.
items.pattern_zh: 根本原因是 {原因}，導致 {中間效應}，最終造成 {失效}。
items.filled_example: The root cause is a slow chamber pressure drift, which led to a thinner oxide at the wafer edge and resulted in read-disturb failures.

cloze.text: The root ___ is a slow chamber pressure drift, which ___ to a thinner oxide at the wafer edge and ___ in read-disturb failures.

dont.en: The problem is the furnace.
dont.why_zh: 指出設備不等於指出機制。因果鏈要寫完整：原因 → 中間效應 → 失效。

items.scenario_zh: 根因摘要（說明如何確認）
items.pattern: We confirmed the mechanism by {method}; the result matched the excursion lots within {tolerance}.
items.pattern_zh: 我們以 {方法} 確認此機制，結果與異常批次的差異在 {容差} 以內。
items.filled_example: We confirmed the mechanism by running a split at the drifted pressure; the result matched the excursion lots within 0.4 points.

cloze.text: We ___ the mechanism by running a split at the drifted pressure; the result ___ the excursion lots ___ 0.4 points.

dont.en: We believe this is the root cause.
dont.why_zh: believe 不能當證據。沒有重現實驗就寫 suspected root cause，不要寫 confirmed。

items.scenario_zh: 根因摘要（排除其他可能）
items.pattern: We ruled out {alternative} because {evidence}.
items.pattern_zh: 我們排除了 {其他可能}，因為 {證據}。
items.filled_example: We ruled out a package-level issue because the same failure was reproduced at wafer sort before assembly.

cloze.text: We ___ out a package-level issue ___ the same failure was ___ at wafer sort before assembly.

dont.en: It should not be a package issue.
dont.why_zh: should not 沒有證據支撐。排除項要附上是哪一筆資料讓你排除的。

items.scenario_zh: 根因摘要（矯正措施與生效時間）
items.pattern: As corrective action, {change} will be effective from {date} on {scope}.
items.pattern_zh: 作為矯正措施，{變更} 自 {日期} 起適用於 {範圍}。
items.filled_example: As corrective action, the pressure alarm limit will be tightened to plus or minus 3 percent, effective from WW35 on all furnaces of the same type.

cloze.text: As ___ action, the pressure alarm limit will be ___ to plus or minus 3 percent, ___ from WW35 on all furnaces of the same type.

dont.en: We will control the pressure better.
dont.why_zh: 矯正措施要寫成可稽核的規格變更：改成什麼數值、何時生效、涵蓋哪些機台。

items.scenario_zh: 根因摘要（防止再發與橫向展開）
items.pattern: To prevent recurrence, we also applied the same check to {other_scope} and found {finding}.
items.pattern_zh: 為防止再發，我們也將同樣的檢查橫向展開到 {其他範圍}，結果 {發現}。
items.filled_example: To prevent recurrence, we also applied the same check to the other three furnace types and found no similar drift.

cloze.text: To ___ recurrence, we also ___ the same check to the other three furnace types and ___ no similar drift.

dont.en: This will not happen again.
dont.why_zh: 空口保證沒有價值。橫向展開的範圍與結果才是客戶要的 D7。

items.scenario_zh: 回覆客訴（先確認收到與時程）
items.pattern: Thank you for reporting this. We have opened case {case_id} and will respond with {deliverable} by {date}.
items.pattern_zh: 感謝通報。我們已開立案件 {案號}，將於 {日期} 前提供 {交付項目}。
items.filled_example: Thank you for reporting this. We have opened case QC-2208-17 and will respond with an interim analysis by 26 August.

cloze.text: Thank you for ___ this. We have ___ case QC-2208-17 and will ___ with an interim analysis by 26 August.

dont.en: We received your mail.
dont.why_zh: 確認收到要連案號與回覆日期一起給，對方才知道這件事真的進了流程。

items.scenario_zh: 回覆客訴（要求補充資料）
items.pattern: To proceed with the analysis, could you provide {data1} and {data2}? Without these we cannot {blocked_action}.
items.pattern_zh: 為了進行分析，可否提供 {資料1} 與 {資料2}？沒有這些我們無法 {受阻的動作}。
items.filled_example: To proceed with the analysis, could you provide the failing unit serial numbers and the test conditions? Without these we cannot trace the parent lots.

cloze.text: To ___ with the analysis, could you ___ the failing unit serial numbers and the test conditions? ___ these we cannot trace the parent lots.

dont.en: Please send more information.
dont.why_zh: 要具體到欄位。含糊的補件要求會來回三四趟，每一趟都是你的時程在流失。

items.scenario_zh: 回覆客訴（責任不在我方時）
items.pattern: Our analysis shows the parts meet {spec}. The failures correlate with {customer_condition}, which exceeds the condition assumed in our qualification.
items.pattern_zh: 我方分析顯示產品符合 {規格}。失效與 {客戶端條件} 相關，而該條件已超出我們認證時所假設的範圍。
items.filled_example: Our analysis shows the parts meet the endurance specification. The failures correlate with the read count per block, which exceeds the condition assumed in our qualification.

cloze.text: Our analysis shows the parts ___ the endurance specification. The failures ___ with the read count per block, which ___ the condition assumed in our qualification.

dont.en: This is your fault, not ours.
dont.why_zh: 就算你是對的，這樣寫也會讓案子升到雙方管理層。用資料說話，語氣保持中性。

items.scenario_zh: 回覆客訴（提出共同檢視）
items.pattern: We propose a joint review of {topic} before we consider {big_change}.
items.pattern_zh: 在考慮 {重大變更} 之前，我們建議先共同檢視 {主題}。
items.filled_example: We propose a joint review of the usage model before we consider any design change.

cloze.text: We ___ a ___ review of the usage model ___ we consider any design change.

dont.en: We will not change the design.
dont.why_zh: 直接拒絕會關上談判空間。joint review 讓對方有台階，也讓你有時間收集資料。

items.scenario_zh: 回覆客訴（補償或後續處置）
items.pattern: For the {quantity} affected units, we will {remedy}. Please confirm whether you prefer {option1} or {option2}.
items.pattern_zh: 針對受影響的 {數量} 顆，我們將 {處置方式}。請確認貴司希望採 {選項1} 或 {選項2}。
items.filled_example: For the 240 affected units, we will replace the material at no charge. Please confirm whether you prefer replacement or credit.

cloze.text: For the 240 ___ units, we will ___ the material at no charge. Please ___ whether you prefer replacement or credit.

dont.en: We can discuss compensation later.
dont.why_zh: 把處置往後拖只會讓客訴一直開著。先給兩個選項，讓對方做選擇題。

items.scenario_zh: 申請特採（說明偏差與範圍）
items.pattern: We request a one-time waiver for {quantity} units of {product}, which deviate from {spec_item} by {amount}.
items.pattern_zh: 我們申請一次性特採 {數量} 顆 {產品}，該批於 {規格項目} 上偏離 {幅度}。
items.filled_example: We request a one-time waiver for 3,000 units of NF128, which deviate from the standby current limit by 4 percent.

cloze.text: We ___ a one-time ___ for 3,000 units of NF128, which ___ from the standby current limit by 4 percent.

dont.en: The units are slightly out of spec, please accept them.
dont.why_zh: slightly 是主觀字。特採一定要寫出數量、規格項目與精確偏離幅度。

items.scenario_zh: 申請特採（提出佐證資料）
items.pattern: As justification, {evidence} shows no impact on {risk_area} over {condition}.
items.pattern_zh: 作為佐證，{證據} 顯示在 {條件} 下對 {風險項目} 無影響。
items.filled_example: As justification, the reliability data shows no impact on retention over 1,000 hours at 125 degrees Celsius.

cloze.text: As ___, the reliability data shows no ___ on retention ___ 1,000 hours at 125 degrees Celsius.

dont.en: We think it will be fine.
dont.why_zh: 特採審查看的是資料。沒有可靠度或量測資料佐證的特採申請通常直接被退。

items.scenario_zh: 申請特採（限定範圍避免變成慣例）
items.pattern: This waiver applies only to {scope} and does not change {baseline}. Future shipments will meet {spec_item}.
items.pattern_zh: 本特採僅適用於 {範圍}，不變更 {基準}。後續出貨將符合 {規格項目}。
items.filled_example: This waiver applies only to lot A123 and does not change the datasheet limit. Future shipments will meet the original standby current spec.

cloze.text: This waiver ___ only to lot A123 and does not ___ the datasheet limit. Future shipments will ___ the original standby current spec.

dont.en: We hope you can accept this level from now on.
dont.why_zh: 特採一旦被讀成永久放寬，等於偷改規格。範圍限定句一定要寫。

items.scenario_zh: 申請特採（說明已採取的補償措施）
items.pattern: To offset the risk, we added {extra_control} for these units and will report {monitoring} monthly.
items.pattern_zh: 為抵銷風險，我們對這批加做了 {額外管控}，並將每月回報 {監控項目}。
items.filled_example: To offset the risk, we added 100 percent screening for these units and will report the field return rate monthly.

cloze.text: To ___ the risk, we ___ 100 percent screening for these units and will ___ the field return rate monthly.

dont.en: We will be more careful with these units.
dont.why_zh: careful 不是管控。要寫出加做了什麼測試、回報什麼指標、多久回報一次。

items.scenario_zh: 申請特採（請對方簽核）
items.pattern: Please confirm your approval by {date} so that we can release the shipment on {ship_date}.
items.pattern_zh: 請於 {日期} 前確認核准，以便我們於 {出貨日} 放行出貨。
items.filled_example: Please confirm your approval by 29 August so that we can release the shipment on 31 August.

cloze.text: Please ___ your approval by 29 August ___ that we can ___ the shipment on 31 August.

dont.en: Let us know if you agree.
dont.why_zh: 沒有期限的簽核請求會被壓在信箱最底層。要把「幾號前回覆」與「回覆才能出貨」綁在一起。
